author: Felipe Bordeu
description:
# Read and Display a Mesh

This workflow demonstrates a simple mesh-loading pipeline:

**Select file → Read Mesh (Muscat) → To 3D View**

It loads the bundled `FlowGraph.stl` and displays it with solid coloring and an axis grid. No mesh transformations or exports are performed.

## Try it

1. Choose **Demos → Add demo files to temporary user files**.
2. Optionally choose **View → Show All Node Details** to inspect the file path and display options.
3. Click **Run workflow**, then open the **3D View** to inspect the mesh.

To use your own mesh, make it available through **User Files** and update the **Select file** path. If the mesh contains a suitable scalar field, select it under **Color field** for field-based coloring.

> **Requirement:** The execution backend must provide **Muscat**. Temporary demo files must be added again in each new session.
